title: Arc hero
description: A centred fintech hero on a pale grey band: a 64px regular-weight headline over two lines, a short warm-grey paragraph, a filled and an outlined square-cornered button, then a full-width product screenshot with an 8px radius and a very long, faint shadow. The grey band stops 120px above the screenshot's foot so it seems to sit on the page. The screenshot fades and rises in on load.
notes: the screenshot slot is a white hairlined placeholder until you pass media
place it straight after the arc header: both use the muted colour so they read as one band
